# A package from the module cache compiles under the same key wherever
# GOMODCACHE is. Its source is fixed by its module version, and its compile
# names that source as module@version.

env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
mkdir $GOCACHE

env GOMODCACHE=$WORK/cacheA
go get rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2
go list -export -deps -f '{{if .Module}}{{if .Module.Version}}{{.ImportPath}} {{.BuildID}}{{end}}{{end}}' m
stdout '^rsc.io/quote '
cp stdout first.txt

env GOMODCACHE=$WORK/cacheB
go mod download rsc.io/quote
go list -export -deps -f '{{if .Module}}{{if .Module.Version}}{{.ImportPath}} {{.BuildID}}{{end}}{{end}}' m
cp stdout second.txt
cmp first.txt second.txt

# The main module still keys on its directory: its compile names the
# absolute path, so a stack trace leads to the file on this machine.
go list -export -f '{{.BuildID}}' m
cp stdout main-first.txt
mkdir $WORK/elsewhere
cp go.mod $WORK/elsewhere/go.mod
cp go.sum $WORK/elsewhere/go.sum
cp m.go $WORK/elsewhere/m.go
cd $WORK/elsewhere
go list -export -f '{{.BuildID}}' m
cp stdout $WORK/gopath/src/main-second.txt
cd $WORK/gopath/src
! cmp main-first.txt main-second.txt

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.20
-- m.go --
package m

import _ "rsc.io/quote"
